name: kube-linter
description: Static analysis tool for Kubernetes YAML files and security best practices

kube-linter.description: Static analysis tool for Kubernetes YAML files and security best practices
kube-linter.usage:
kube-linter lint deployment.yaml # Lint single file
kube-linter lint k8s/ # Lint directory
kube-linter lint --config custom.yaml manifests/ # Custom configuration
kube-linter list checks # Show available checks
